info.name: X API v2 Account Activity Connections API

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by connection status. Use 'active' for current connections, 'inactive' for historical/disconnected connections, or 'all' for both.

params.name: endpoints
params.description: Filter by streaming endpoint. Specify one or more endpoint names to filter results.

params.name: max_results
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: pagination_token
params.description: Token for paginating through results. Use the value from 'next_token' in the previous response.

params.name: connection.fields
params.description: A comma separated list of Connection fields to display.

items.docs: Returns active and historical streaming connections with disconnect reasons for the authenticated application.
Terminates multiple streaming connections by their UUIDs for the authenticated application.
Terminates all active streaming connections for the authenticated application.

params.name: endpoint_id
params.description: The endpoint ID to terminate connections for.

items.docs: Terminates all streaming connections for a specific endpoint ID for the authenticated application.
